_comment: State for the nightly DXEdge health check. Written by the scheduled Claude run at 9:00 PM PT. Read this first, write it back at the end of every run, including quiet nights.

cert.evidence: https://dxedge.net/api/health fetched cleanly over TLS, no CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED
cert.notes: cert_repair.sh guard and /etc/cron.d/dxedge-certbot in place since 2026-08-31

main_dashboard.diagnosis: sat_tles and pota_spots in /api/health are PASSIVE cache reads. Nothing repopulates them on a timer: sat TLEs are fetched only when /api/satellites/* is hit (6h TTL) and POTA only when /api/pota or /api/activations is hit (120s TTL). Both therefore read 0 whenever the cache is cold, which is most of the time. Verified live this run: /api/satellites/positions returned 9 satellites, /api/pota returned 11 spots, api.pota.app and db.satnogs.org both answered 200 directly. NOT a broken feed. Do not re-investigate as an outage; only escalate if the endpoints themselves fail.

cyber_page.browser_check: not possible - no browser reachable in this scheduled cloud run

feeds_via_api_feed.nvd_2.0: ok without date params; the page's date-bearing URL could not be re-verified from this environment (WebFetch mangles the double-encoded query and never reaches the app), but the exact shape is present in the server cache from 2026-08-31 and the code path is unchanged
feeds_via_api_feed.theregister: still failing, 403 from upstream through the proxy - known and already reported 2026-08-31, do not re-report

aethersdr_page.browser_check: not possible - no browser reachable in this scheduled cloud run

runs.outbound_links_skipped_reason: WebFetch to hosts outside dxedge.net returns PROVENANCE_REQUIRED in an unattended scheduled run - each new domain needs a human to approve the fetch, and nobody is present. Step 4 cannot run in this configuration. 155 distinct outbound URLs remain unchecked.
problems_reported: POTA time_utc parser bug (fixed this run)
outbound link checking blocked by fetch approvals (escalated to James 2026-09-01)
backend/tests fails at collection importing estimate_fof2 from voacap_engine (pre-existing, outstanding)
fixes_pushed: backend/pota.py: time_utc sliced a full ISO timestamp to its first 5 characters, so every POTA spot rendered as "2026-". Now formatted like the SOTA parser.

known_issues_do_not_re_report.detail: www.theregister.com/security/headlines.atom 302s and returns 403 to non-browser clients. Likely cannot be served through any server side proxy. Reported already.
sat_tles and pota_spots read 0 in /api/health whenever their caches are cold. Cosmetic, not an outage. See main_dashboard.diagnosis above.
backend/tests imports estimate_fof2 from voacap_engine, which does not exist. Pre-existing break, not caused by the nightly run. Do not paper over by deleting the import.

nginx.conf limits /api/ to 30r/m burst 10 per IP and the cyber page fires several /api/feed calls per load. Nightly checks must pace their requests. Needs its own limit_req zone, which is a nginx.conf change and therefore an escalation, not an autonomous fix.
